main_text.l: prophetices & apostolicis: atque nihil aliud requirit S. patrum, vel totius antiquitatis orthodoxæ cõsensus. Sicut constat ex articulo de judice ac norma controversiarum, in loco de s. scriptura & similibus, 9 Ambrosium et alios patres mandare, quòd fides ecclesiæ imprimis quæreda sit. ʀ esp. Ita, quatenus consentit scripturæ propheticæ & apostolicæ. Ita Ambrosius comm. in Lucam lib. 6. ad cap. 9. Lucæ. Si qua est ecclesia, quæ fidem respuat, nec apostolicæ prædicationis fundamenta posfideat: ne quam labem perfidiæ posfit aspergere, deserenda est. Similia occurrunt passim apud veteres orthodoxos scriptores. 10 Veteres unanimi consensu pontifici Romano adhæsisse. A veteribus episcopis Romanis ad hodiernos non valet consecutio. Plura vide in Medulla papismi pag. 217. & seq. quid item de posterioribus & hodiernis pontificibus Romanis sit statuendum, quámq; graviter à veritate euangelicâ aberra-rint:

page.notes: The marks "ʀ esp." after "sit." are doubtful and may stand for a printed sign. The text runs on without a clear paragraph break after "sit." and before "Ita, quatenus"; I kept it as one paragraph. The numerals 9 and 10 stand in the text block and were not read as marginal references. The final word "aberra-rint:" is hyphenated across the line end as printed.
